installed: Plugin “{name}” installed. It is available in the Process step, among the additional tools, and in the Plugins menu.
updated: Plugin “{name}” updated. It is available in the Process step, among the additional tools, and in the Plugins menu.
enabled: Plugin “{name}” enabled. It is available in the Process step, among the additional tools, and in the Plugins menu.
fromMenuActive: “{name}” is active among the additional tools of the Process step. After adjusting the parameters, press Apply.
fromMenuAlreadyActive: “{name}” is already active among the additional tools of the Process step. After adjusting the parameters, press Apply.
